- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Long Term: Choose this if you need to regularly execute administrative tasks (justification required)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your ABC employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: John Doe (City) (X12K)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: ABC-hjDsyYPL1Oz (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, ABC & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
CCB - Cassa Centrale
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
I need administrator rights for 2 weeks to install specific software required for working on my new project, for example Intellij, SQL...
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rigths are still needed.
- ABC Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base ABC Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the ABC Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from ABC Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of ABC Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between ABC Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a ABC Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base ABC Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the ABC/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- You are also responsible for providing a patch management

Hello,

To restore the GFT VPN on the external collaborator’s replacement laptop, please submit a **Client-to-Site VPN tunnel request**. This request requires approval from a GFT employee manager at **L5 or above**; if the requester is L5 or above, they may enter their own name as approver. - GFT Project Manager and approver
- Destination (GFT server or customer site)
- Destination IP address
- Destination DNS name
- Destination ports/services
- Project name
- Business justification

The request will then undergo an additional review to confirm compliance with GFT network policies.

For the password reset, please also provide:

- David Russo’s phone number, including the international country code
- Device type/operating system of the replacement laptop

Once the required information and approval are provided, the relevant teams can proceed with the password reset and VPN request.

retrieval.reply:

- Need: Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer
- Do you need admin rights for one-time action / software installation?: No I need those rights every week for running and installing software.
- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Long Term: Choose this if you need to regularly execute administrative tasks (justification required)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GFB employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Luca Romano (Milano) (B52D)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GFB-xYTHSQf632p (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GFB & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
Intesa San Paolo
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
I need the admin rights to:
- edit environment variables needed by the projects
- install new developer tools
- update existing developer tools
- update client tools
- install client certificates

- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rigths are still needed.
- GFB Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFB Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFB Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFB Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFB Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFB Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFB Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFB Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GFB/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- Need: Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer
- Do you need admin rights for one-time action / software installation?: No I need those rights every week for running and installing software.
- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Long Term: Choose this if you need to regularly execute administrative tasks (justification required)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your NXY employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accepts persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Claudio Rossi (Milano) (D93X)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: NXY-Jk3uSMxQbNt (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, NXY & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on:
Intesa San Paolo
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
New development tools and environment variables
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- NXY Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base NXY Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the NXY Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from NXY Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of NXY Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:

Approved rights must be renewed after 12 months by submitting a new request.

- General Instructions:

- Project Manager Full name: Roberto Giannini (Rome) (RGIA)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: HNT-A1cD7F8yRJL (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, HNT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
BPER
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
Install different programs
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rigths are still needed.
- HNT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base HNT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the HNT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from HNT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of HNT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between HNT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between an HNT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base HNT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by

feedback.answer:
Hello,

For regular development and debugging activities, please submit the **Local Administration Rights (LAR)** request as a **Long-Term** request. Please provide the following information:

- Full name of your GFT employee manager or project manager (L6 or above) for approval. If you are L6 or above, provide your own name.
- Computer name (Device Name in Company Portal, or run `hostname` in Command Prompt). If it is not listed, select **Not in the list (PC)** and enter the name manually.
- Computer system (for example, Windows).
- Clients and projects you support.
- A detailed justification, including the specific development/debugging tools, software, or administrative actions requiring elevated rights.
- Confirmation from your manager that local administrator rights do not conflict with any client requirements.

Please note that permanent local administrator rights increase security risks and are granted only for recurring business needs with adequate justification. Only authorized, business-related software may be installed, and the workstation’s base installation and security services must not be altered or disabled. You are also responsible for keeping additionally installed software patched.

Approved rights must be renewed after 12 months by submitting a new request.

Hello,

To process this request, please submit the **Administrator Rights / Local Administration Rights (LAR)** request form and provide the following information:

- Whether the access is required for a **one-time action** or regular recurring use
- Whether **temporary short-term** or **long-term** rights are needed
- Full name of your **manager/approver at level L6 or above**  
  *(If you are L6 or above, provide your own name.)*
- Your computer name  
  *(Find it in the Company Portal under **Device name**, or run `hostname` in Command Prompt.)*
- Operating system
- Clients/projects involved
- Justification: enabling and using the **Hyper-V** Windows feature

Please also confirm with your manager that local administrator rights do not conflict with any client requirements. Permanent local admin access is only approved for recurring business needs and must be renewed after 12 months. For a one-time Hyper-V enablement, request temporary rights unless recurring administrative access is required.

query_title: I need administration right on my personal computer
reference_reply:
Below you will find the additional form information for that request and the information you filled out.

- Need: Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer
- Do you need admin rights for one-time action / software installation?: No I need those rights every week for running and installing software.
- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Long Term: Choose this if you need to regularly execute administrative tasks (justification required)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GHT employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accepts persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Leonardo di Marco (Verona) (B23C)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GHT-x9HsRm3opLQ (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GHT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
BPQR
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
Java JDK
IDE
DB Clients
Customer VPN
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GHT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GHT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GHT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GHT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GHT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GHT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GHT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GHT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GHT/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- You are also responsible for providing a patch management process for the software that you additionally installed (with special attention to security patches)

- Clients and projects you support.
- A specific justification, including the software or administrative actions requiring elevated rights.

Please first confirm with your manager that local administrator rights do not conflict with any client requirements. Permanent rights are intended only for recurring business needs and require sufficient justification; approved access must be renewed after 12 months.

Local administrator rights may only be used for approved business-related software. Do not alter the base system installation, disable security services, or install unlicensed or unauthorized software.

Please update the request with the above details/form information so it can be reviewed.

query_title: I need administrator rights on my computer
reference_reply:
Below you will find the additional form information for that request and the information you filled out.

- Need: Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer
- Do you need admin rights for one-time action / software installation?: Yes (Please do not use this subcategory if you need to install Software just one time. Use the Service and Subcategory Windows Software Installation - I need software or a license installed on my computer) do not open this ticket
- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Short Term: Choose this if Group IT cannot perform the task for you (Please do not open this ticket if you need to install software just one time. Use the Service and Subcategory Windows Software Installation - I need software or a license installed on my computer)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your ABC employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: John Doe (Milan) (X123)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: ABC-1A2b3C4D5E6 (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, ABC & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
XYZ
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
DBMS Oracle
SQL Developer
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rigths are still needed.
- ABC Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base ABC Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the ABC Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from ABC Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of ABC Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between ABC Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a ABC Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,

baseline.answer:
Hello,

To request a Jira license and access to the ISPAM project, please provide the following information:

- Is the license for an **Internal** or **External User**?
- **Internal user:** full name, location, and username
- **External user:** full name (if applicable)
- **Jira project:** project key and/or a URL to an issue in the project
- **Justification** for the access

The project key is the prefix in a Jira issue identifier, such as `<PROJECT_KEY>-123`. Please provide a project or issue URL; the Jira portal URL alone is not valid for identifying the project.

Once this information is provided, the Jira license request can be processed.

feedback.answer:
Hello,

Creating a global Java environment variable requires elevated permissions. Please submit the **Local Administration Rights (LAR)** request form rather than requesting administrator rights directly in this ticket.

Please select the appropriate duration:

- **Temporary access** if this is a one-time configuration and cannot be completed by Group IT.
- **Long-term access** only if you regularly perform administrative tasks. This requires a business justification, including the Java/development activities involved.

For a long-term request, please provide:

- Your KLM manager’s full name (L6 or above) for approval. If you are L6 or above, enter your own name.
- Your computer name, available in Company Portal under **Device Name** or by running `hostname` in Command Prompt.
- The clients/projects concerned.
- Confirmation that local administrator rights do not conflict with any client requirements.

Approved local administrator rights are valid for 12 months and must then be renewed. Please also note that permanent administrator access increases security risk and is granted only where regular business activities require it.

New development tools and environment variables

Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base NXY Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the NXY Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from NXY Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of NXY Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between NXY Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a NXY Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base NXY Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.

- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Short Term: Choose this if Group IT cannot perform the task for you (Please do not open this ticket if you need to install software just one time. - General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your XYZ employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Marco Polano (Milano) (GEAL)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: XYZ-QaYzNCygZbK (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, XYZ & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
AlphaBank
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
WC32070
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- XYZ Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base XYZ Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the XYZ Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from XYZ Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of XYZ Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between XYZ Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a XYZ Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base XYZ Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized

baseline.answer:
Hello,

Please submit a **Local Administration Rights** request through the appropriate service form. To process it, include:

- Whether the access is required for a one-time installation or recurring administrative tasks
- If temporary or long-term access is required, with the requested duration
- Your GFT employee manager or alternative approver at level L6 or above
- Project/client name
- Full list of software and actions requiring administrator privileges, including business justification
- Computer name and operating system

You can find the computer name in the Company Portal under **Device name**, or by running `hostname` in Command Prompt. If the computer is not listed in the form, select **Not in the list (PC)** and enter the name manually.

Please confirm with your manager that local administrator rights are permitted under the relevant client agreement. Long-term rights require sufficient justification and must be renewed after 12 months.

If this is only for a **one-time software installation**, please use the **Windows Software Installation – I need software or a license installed on my computer** service instead.

- Extension important Information:
1. Extension purpose in Azure DevOps: Description about your understanding of extension, eg. This extension is designed to integrate <sth> into your build pipeline. It allows <sth>.
2. Extension URL: Url to extension, can be Url to marketplace.
3. Extension description: Generic short description of the extension.
4. Extension publisher company: Description of extension’s publisher, eg. "<name>, which is a reputable source. <name> is widely recognized in the industry for its <sth>".
5. Extension top publisher badge: Does this extension’s provider have a top publisher badge in the marketplace?.
6. Extension Shared or Private: Is this extension’s type shared (public) or private?.
7. Extension updates timeline: Give examples of two latest extension’s updates (version and date of latest and previous updates), eg. "Latest: 5.18.4 on 28-11-2023, Previous: 5.18.3 on 20-11-2023".
8. Extension permissions needed: Which permissions are needed to install this extension? eg. Build (read), Code (read).
9. Extension customer opinions: Overall rate and number of opinions, eg. 2.9/5 (82 reviews).
10. Extension data location: Where user data is stored? eg. "User data is stored in …" or "The specific location of user data isn't explicitly mentioned in the code" or "No information".
11. Extension Egress to / Ingress from external applications: Are connections to/from external applications, based this extension, being controlled by GFT? eg. "Network communications are primarily related to interactions with Azure DevOps and <name> APIs".
12. Extension Publisher sec. certification: Does an extension’s publisher have security certifications? eg. "ISO 27001:2013 certification at the company level" or "<name> also undergoes frequent and rigorous penetration tests conducted by external companies".

jdk
maven

postman

- GFG Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFG Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFG Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFG Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFG Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFG Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFG Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFG Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GFG/IT Infrastructure

feedback.answer:
Please submit this through the **“Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer”** service if you need to regularly run or install the development tools.

Please provide:

- Whether admin rights are required regularly or only for a one-time installation
- Your manager’s full name (L6 or above) for approval; if you are L6 or above, provide your own name
- Computer name (Device Name in Company Portal, or run `hostname` in Command Prompt)
- Computer system
- Client and project
- Full list of software/actions requiring admin rights, such as JDK, Maven, Spring Tool Suite, or Postman

Please also confirm with your manager that the requested software and local administrator access comply with the applicable client requirements. Local admin rights are restricted to approved business software and must not be used to alter the base system or disable security services. Approved rights require renewal after 12 months.

Just as a hint, are you sure that the url is correct?

I had a quick look and I can see https://github.com/xyz-corp on the browser, but https://github.com/xyz-corp/xyz-project-app.git gives me a 404 error. And in https://github.com/xyz-corp I can only see 2 repos and none of them are xyz-project-app. Of course this can be because I'm not sign in or I'm not looking at the right place.

Regards,

baseline.answer:
Hi,

Please connect to the GFT VPN and try accessing the repository using SSH instead of HTTPS. In Git, update the repository’s remote URL from the HTTPS address to the corresponding SSH URL, then retry the pull or checkout.

If the issue persists while connected to the VPN, please provide the exact SSH error message for further investigation.

Best regards,

reference_reply:
Below you will find the additional form information for that request and the information you filled out.

- Need: Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer
- Do you need admin rights for one-time action / software installation?: No I need those rights every week for running and installing software.
- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Long Term: Choose this if you need to regularly execute administrative tasks (justification required)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GFT employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Jane Smith (Milano) (B45G)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GFT-AbCdEf12345 (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GFT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
IBEF Max Mara
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
As part of my day-to-day duties, I am frequently required to modify system variables and the host file on my workstation.
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages

baseline.answer:
Hello,

Your request is treated as a **long-term Local Administrator Rights (LAR)** request because you need to regularly modify environment variables and the Windows hosts file.

Please provide the following information so the request can be assessed:

- Full name of your GFT manager/approver at **L6 or above**. If you are L6 or above, provide your own name.
- Computer name. You can find it under **Device Name** in the Company Portal, or by running `hostname` in Command Prompt.
- Clients and projects you support.
- Detailed justification, including the administrative actions and any software involved.
- Confirmation that your manager has verified that local administrator rights do not conflict with client requirements.

Please note that permanent local administrator rights increase the risk to the workstation and client infrastructure. Rights are intended only for recurring business activities, must be used in accordance with the GFT Local Admin Rights Policy, and must not be used to alter the base system installation or disable security protections. Approved rights must be renewed after 12 months.

If the requirement is only for a one-time task, please request short-term access instead; Group IT should perform the task where possible.

Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GFT/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- You are also responsible for providing a patch

Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
BBPM - PEF
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
NVM
Node JS
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rigths are still needed.
- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software
